findings: Screen signal sources require the same active screen session ID; Voice sources require the same active voice call ID
a late Screen signal or media-ready failure cannot write MEDIA_NOT_ACCEPTED after that Screen capability becomes terminal
a current active Screen invitation still preserves a real MEDIA_NOT_ACCEPTED response
performEnsureBinding validates both media lifecycle generation and currentBindingKey before applying a successful result
late bind failures are rejected by markBindingFailure when the current binding key changed
finalizeScreen clears only the Screen capability error and a matching Screen signal error
closePeerIfIdle performs global cleanup only when neither Screen nor Voice remains active
an active Voice capability and its capability-specific error survive Screen finalization
the prior capability-neutral ownership for merged Screen and Voice negotiation is preserved
